title: The Star Geometry of Critic-Based Regularizer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2408.16852v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Variational regularization is a classical technique to solve statistical inference tasks and inverse problems, with modern data-driven approaches parameterizing regularizers via deep neural networks showcasing impressive empirical performance. Recent works along these lines learn task-dependent regularizers. This is done by integrating information about the measurements and ground-truth data in an unsupervised, critic-based loss function, where the regularizer attributes low values to likely data and high values to unlikely data. However, there is little theory about the structure of regularizers learned via this process and how it relates to the two data distributions. To make progress on this challenge, we initiate a study of optimizing critic-based loss functions to learn regularizers over a particular family of regularizers: gauges (or Minkowski functionals) of star-shaped bodies. translated_title: 基于评论器的正则化器学习中的星形几何
translated_abstract: 变分正则化是解决统计推断任务和逆问题的一种经典技术，而现代数据驱动方法通过深度神经网络对正则化器进行参数化，展现出令人瞩目的实证性能。沿此思路的最新研究学习依赖于具体任务的正则化器：其做法是在一个无监督的、基于评论器的损失函数中融合测量数据与真实数据的信息，其中正则化器为可能的数据赋予较低的值，为不太可能的数据赋予较高的值。然而，关于通过这一过程学习到的正则化器具有何种结构，以及它与两种数据分布之间的关系，目前几乎没有相关理论。为了在这一挑战上取得进展，我们开创性地研究了在特定正则化器族——星形体的规范函数（gauge，即 Minkowski 泛函）——上优化基于评论器的损失函数以学习正则化器。该正则化器族包含了常见的……
tldr: 该论文开创性地研究了在星形体的规范函数这一正则化器族上优化基于评论器的损失函数，为学习到的任务相关正则化器的结构及其与测量数据和真实数据分布之间的几何联系提供了首个理论视角。
en_tdlr: This paper initiates a theoretical study of critic-based regularizer learning over the family of gauges of star-shaped bodies, revealing the geometry linking learned task-dependent regularizers to the measurement and ground-truth data distributions.
